qualification_envelope.scope_rule: A future qualification or activation claim is limited to the exact supported cells; aggregate six-subject coverage remains partial.

packet.selection_order: outcome-blind round-robin by supported source family, mechanism cell, then stable hash
packet.family_floor: all four supported source families contribute at least one identity
packet.family_ceiling: no family contributes more than 20 identities
packet.shortfall: stop as insufficient without source activation, substitution, or post-outcome repair
packet.outcome_classes: both classes required after blinded review; one-class outcomes are insufficient

terminal_contract.pairing: exactly one terminal observation per arm per frozen identity
terminal_contract.outcome_blinding: both arm observations and chronology freeze before outcomes

metrics: provider input, output, cache-read, and cache-write tokens

decision_rules.recall_semantics: Only confirmed recalls an actionable outcome; all other terminal states are not recalled and remain visible.
decision_rules.G04: Agent recall is at least baseline recall overall and in every reportable subgroup, with zero actionable identity confirmed by baseline but not confirmed by agent.
decision_rules.G03b: G04 passes; agent precision is at least baseline precision; terminal observations and usage are complete; cost per uniquely validated issue is available; and the agent is Pareto-no-worse on unique validated issues, precision, recall, abstention coverage, and cost per uniquely validated issue with at least one strict improvement.
decision_rules.subgroups: Family, mechanism, language, and detector subgroups require pre-outcome membership, both outcome classes, and complete paired observations; an unreportable required subgroup blocks a broad pass.
decision_rules.undefined: Undefined metrics and unknown usage or pricing remain unavailable and block a pass.

tool_bounds.failure: terminal abstention or failure; no fallback interface
